nodes.text: I know you're interested in Kevin, and I bet he's probably interested in you.

nodes.text: You're just giving up?!

nodes.subtitle: Can Owen find Paige during Spring Break?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Owen...
It's lunch time, and Owen's using one hand to hold open a book called `'Robotics and Jocks: What To Do With a Sweaty Servo'.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's lunch time, and Owen's using one hand to hold open a book called [b]'Robotics and Jocks: What To Do With a Sweaty Servo'.[/b]

nodes.text: With his other hand, he inspects and probes a tiny robot, laying lifeless on the table next to his lunch, which has long gone cold.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Come on! Come on! Please work this time!
He brings two wires together... Sparks shoot out every which way! The robot's eyes glow bright for a second, only to fade again.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You stupid thing!
Kimi and $ZOE arrive, with Emily wheeling Ben up behind them. They all sit down around Owen.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Robo-surgery doesn't look like it's going well.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I know, and in twenty minutes, I've gotta prove to the nerds that I'm competent enough to join the Robotics Club!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I hope you do! Otherwise you'll never find Paige!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Man, I missed `one` awesome mission to Monarch Prep because of my broken leg, and now I'm behind. What does Owen joining Robotics Club have to do with Paige?
nodes.text_bbcode: Man, I missed [color=#e23b3b][i]one[/i][/color] awesome mission to Monarch Prep because of my broken leg, and now I'm behind. What does Owen joining Robotics Club have to do with Paige?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's so simple, Ben! Owen just has to get good at robotics so he can join the Robotics Club so he can get into a hotel for Spring Break so he can find Paige!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `So` simple. But could I, uh, get a version that includes breaths for air?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]So[/i][/color] simple. But could I, uh, get a version that includes breaths for air?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee. When we snuck Owen into Monarch Prep, he found out that Paige is going to be at a Debutante Dance in a hotel near Centerscore Beach this weekend!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Right, I remember someone unimportant telling me about that.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: And `someone's` going to break his other leg if he's not careful...
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#3b78e2][i]someone's[/i][/color] going to break his other leg if he's not careful...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Heh. Anyway, I tried to get a hotel room, but every hotel is booked! Turns out there are a million different events going on this weekend!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Including `Robo-Con!` Gonna get my nerd on with the Robotics Club!
nodes.text_bbcode: Including [color=#e23b3b][i]Robo-Con![/i][/color] Gonna get my nerd on with the Robotics Club!

nodes.text: Ben does a little dance in his wheelchair.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I don't know if you know this, Ben, but for participating in the tournament, `The Computition,` we get to stay at the hotel for `free!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know if you know this, Ben, but for participating in the tournament, [color=#3b78e2][i]The Computition,[/i][/color] we get to stay at the hotel for [color=#3b78e2][i]free![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We do? Sweet! Free is my favorite price!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: As soon as I heard that the Robotics Club has a hotel room, I asked Kimi if she could get me in!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Aaaaaaand... I'm caught up! How's studying going?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, when Brendan told me that I only had to be of `some` use, I thought I was a lock to be accepted. How hard could it be?
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, when Brendan told me that I only had to be of [color=#e23b3b][i]some[/i][/color] use, I thought I was a lock to be accepted. How hard could it be?

nodes.text: Owen gestures sadly toward his robot.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Turns out, pretty hard. This one-second lightbulb isn't going to cut it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awww! It's kind of cute to me.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: The thing is... I've never wanted anything more than I do now!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I just want to talk to Paige...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: To tell her that my kiss with $ZOE during the play was... Was exactly what it was, a stage-kiss and nothing more.
$ZOE nods her head, agreeing.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I just want to tell Paige how I really feel.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, man, Robotics 101... `Don't give up.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, man, Robotics 101... [color=#e23b3b][i]Don't give up.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No offense, but I could use advice that's a little more...
